title: Ephemeral source-port exhaustion from short-lived outbound connections
source_note: Failure pattern (a service opening many short-lived outbound connections exhausts the ephemeral source-port range as TIME_WAIT sockets accumulate, so new outbound connections fail) is a classic OS-level resource-exhaustion class. All services, log lines, metrics, and timestamps are fabricated for evaluation.
incident_report: Since ~04:30 UTC the sync-service is intermittently failing to reach the upstream API - about 20% of calls. The upstream is healthy. No deploys. Traffic is a bit higher than usual overnight due to a batch window.

signal_lines.msg: outbound connections to upstream-api occasionally failing: cannot assign requested address (EADDRNOTAVAIL)
sockets in TIME_WAIT to upstream-api: 27000 and rising; each request opens a fresh connection (no keep-alive)
ephemeral port range (32768-60999) exhausted; ~20% of outbound calls failing to get a source port
upstream-api latency and error rate normal from other clients; issue is local socket exhaustion
enabled HTTP keep-alive / connection pooling to upstream-api; TIME_WAIT count falling, errors clearing

ground_truth.root_cause: sync-service opens a fresh outbound TCP connection to upstream-api for every request with no HTTP keep-alive, so closed connections pile up in TIME_WAIT. During the higher-volume overnight batch window, the TIME_WAIT count climbed past 27,000 and exhausted the host's ephemeral source-port range (32768-60999). With no source port available, ~20% of new outbound calls failed with 'cannot assign requested address'. upstream-api is healthy - the exhaustion is local. Recovery required enabling connection pooling / keep-alive so connections are reused instead of recreated.
evidence_path: sync-service WARN: outbound connections failing with EADDRNOTAVAIL ('cannot assign requested address')
sync-service WARN: 27000+ TIME_WAIT sockets to upstream-api; every request opens a fresh connection (no keep-alive)
sync-service ERROR: ephemeral port range (32768-60999) exhausted; ~20% of calls cannot get a source port
upstream-api confirmed healthy for other clients - the exhaustion is local to sync-service
errors clear after HTTP keep-alive / connection pooling is enabled
ground_truth.fix: Enable HTTP keep-alive and a bounded connection pool to upstream-api (done). Reduce the TIME_WAIT window where safe, widen the ephemeral port range, and alert on TIME_WAIT socket count.
